commonInvariants.authorityRule: Only the user can commit a CanonicalEffect. A model, agent, tool, signature, hash, Provider result, or consensus may propose or evidence but never accept, resolve, waive, close, supersede, or redirect research on the user's behalf. The Kernel only executes a user command.
commonInvariants.atomicityRule: Every successful CanonicalEffect commits atomically in one database transaction: resulting object(s), project revision event and head advance, Review terminal state, and the transition Receipt/Trace either all succeed or all roll back. No partial canonical mutation may remain observable.
commonInvariants.effectIdRule: effectId is system-generated by the Kernel and stays stable across preview, edit, and commit. IDs are project-scoped, prefix-validated, and never generated by the renderer or any external interface.
commonInvariants.previewHashRule: previewHash binds the exact effect payload and base project state. Any payload, target version, or base revision change invalidates the preview hash; a stale preview can never be committed.
commonInvariants.baseRevisionRule: baseProjectStateRevision records the projectStateRevision the effect preview was computed against; commit requires the current head to match it (optimistic concurrency).
commonInvariants.publicReasonRule: Every effect carries a short public structured reason. Hidden reasoning is never stored or sent.
commonInvariants.expectedVersionsRule: Every effect that mutates an existing object carries expectedObjectVersions; the Kernel enforces compare-and-swap on each target version.
commonInvariants.externalBoundary: No external interface (UI transport, CLI, MCP, Skill, Host bridge, Provider) may invoke an effect directly. All effects flow through the Research Deliberation Kernel via a committed Review; adapters are thin transports only.

authorityCommand.idempotencyKey: authorityCommandId is a system-generated idempotency key bound to (reviewId, effectId, previewHash, expectedProjectStateRevision, user actor). Re-submitting the same key returns the already-committed result; never replays the mutation.
authorityCommand.actorValidation: ResearchActor.kind must equal "user" plus an active local session capability. Provider, Host, Skill, MCP, Memory, Receipt, Migration, and Kernel-internal actors can never submit an Authority command.
authorityCommand.confirmationRequirement: The user must explicitly confirm the rendered effect preview (target, before/after, objects not changed, resulting object identity, rollback mode) before the command is submitted. There is no implicit approval.
authorityCommand.retrySemantics: Retry with the same authorityCommandId is idempotent. A different command using an already-allocated target id returns an idempotency conflict and never double-creates the object.

effects.userVisibleName: Record only; no research object changed
effects.userVisibleNameZh: 仅记录，不改变研究对象
effects.authority: user_recorded workflow outcome; user_only commit; no Provider involvement can gate it
effects.input: outcome in (rejected, deferred, reference_only, assessment_disputed) plus a public reason; carries no target mutation
preconditions: Review is not stale relative to its baseProjectStateRevision
outcome value is valid and reason is non-empty
no target mutation payload may be attached
revisionPreconditions: baseProjectStateRevision equals the current projectStateRevision head at commit
effect preview hash matches the submitted preview
effects.mutationTargets: Review terminal state (disposed) and transition Receipt only; Brief/Decision/Issue/Evidence are explicitly not changed
receiptRequirements: one transition Receipt written in the same transaction
Receipt records before/after projectStateRevision and the record_only outcome
Receipt must state that no canonical research object was created or updated
traceRequirements: one revision event with effectKind=record_only is appended in the same transaction
Trace records actor, public reason, Review id, and changedObjectRefs empty
effects.failureSemantics: Any precondition or repository failure rolls back the whole transaction; the Review stays in its pre-commit state and no Receipt, event, or revision advance is observable
effects.idempotencySemantics: Retry with the same authorityCommandId returns the existing Receipt; a second independent record_only command is a new, separate transaction
effects.resultingObject: terminal Review (disposed) plus Receipt; no research object

effects.authority: user_recorded direction decision; user_only commit; the decision does not assert that any claim is factually true
effects.input: preallocated decision id (create) or existing decision id (update) plus statement, rationale, scope, expected version when updating
preconditions: statement and rationale are non-empty and bounded
preallocated id is project-scoped and Kernel-generated
updates carry the exact expected version of the existing decision
revisionPreconditions: baseProjectStateRevision equals the current head at commit
preview hash matches; expectedObjectVersions match current versions
effects.mutationTargets: ResearchDecision aggregate (create or compare-and-swap transition), Review terminal state (committed), revision head/event, Receipt
receiptRequirements: Receipt references resulting decision id and version, before/after revision, effect preview hash, and Manifest identity when a Provider attempt existed
traceRequirements: revision event with effectKind=create_decision and changedObjectRefs containing the decision id
effects.failureSemantics: version conflict or repository failure rolls back everything; no half-created decision or orphan Receipt remains
effects.idempotencySemantics: same authorityCommandId retries return the already-created decision; a different command with the same preallocated id conflicts and never creates a second decision

effects.authority: user_recorded evidence record; user_only commit; recording is not proof of fact and support status is governed by the Evidence domain, never by a Provider verdict
effects.input: preallocated evidence id, evidence kind, summary, provenance/source, support relation (when linked), related claim/issue refs, inference capacity
preconditions: provenance/source fields are present; missing provenance blocks the commit
evidence kind, state, inference capacity match the canonical Evidence enums of the chosen aggregate
a Provider suggestion can never set support status to proven by itself
revisionPreconditions: baseProjectStateRevision equals the current head at commit
effects.mutationTargets: the single canonical Evidence aggregate (argument_evidence, revd_ id), optional claim/mechanism evidence links, Review terminal state, revision head/event, Receipt
receiptRequirements: Receipt references the resulting evidence id/version and before/after revision; assessment availability is recorded independently and never upgrades support status
traceRequirements: revision event with effectKind=add_evidence and changedObjectRefs containing the evidence id and any link ids
effects.failureSemantics: missing provenance, invalid enums, or repository failure rolls back the whole transaction; no orphan evidence row or link survives
effects.idempotencySemantics: same authorityCommandId retries return the existing evidence record; duplicate evidence content is additionally guarded by the aggregate's content-hash rules

effects.userVisibleName: Create or resolve a research issue
effects.input: mode (create or resolve), issue kind/summary (create) or resolution plus expected version (resolve); resolution evidence reference when applicable
preconditions: create: kind and summary valid; resolve: current issue status allows resolution and expected version matches
resolution evidence reference, when present, points at current canonical Evidence
revisionPreconditions: baseProjectStateRevision equals the current head at commit
effects.mutationTargets: ResearchIssue aggregate transition, Review terminal state, revision head/event, Receipt
receiptRequirements: Receipt references resulting issue id/status/version and before/after revision
traceRequirements: revision event with effectKind=create_or_resolve_issue and changedObjectRefs containing the issue id
effects.failureSemantics: stale version or repository failure rolls back; resolving an already-resolved issue is an idempotent success or explicit no-op, never a second resolution
effects.idempotencySemantics: same authorityCommandId retries return the existing result; repeated resolve of the same issue is a no-op with the same outcome

effects.input: typed field patch against the active Brief version plus public reason; diff is computed by the Kernel
preconditions: patch is typed and validated field-by-field
active Brief version is the base version; no silent rebase
revisionPreconditions: baseProjectStateRevision equals the current head at commit
active Brief version unchanged since preview; otherwise the diff is recomputed and re-confirmed
effects.mutationTargets: new Brief version superseding the active version, Review terminal state, revision head/event, Receipt
receiptRequirements: Receipt references the new Brief version id/number and before/after revision
traceRequirements: revision event with effectKind=patch_brief and changedObjectRefs containing the new Brief version id
effects.failureSemantics: stale candidate or repository failure rolls back; the active Brief never changes without a confirmed new version
effects.idempotencySemantics: same authorityCommandId retries return the existing new version; a second confirmed patch is a new version, never an overwrite

effects.authority: user_direction_authority; user_only commit; this is a direction decision, not a claim that facts became true
effects.input: new question, supersession reason, impact summary; the preview lists which pending Reviews and Manifests will become stale
preconditions: new question is non-empty and differs from the current question
supersession reason and impact summary are present
preview enumerates pending Reviews/Manifests that will go stale
revisionPreconditions: baseProjectStateRevision equals the current head at commit
effects.mutationTargets: new Brief version with prior question marked superseded, Review terminal state, revision head/event, Receipt; stale flags for affected pending Reviews
receiptRequirements: Receipt references the new Brief version and the prior question supersession marker
traceRequirements: revision event with effectKind=formal_direction_change; old question is never deleted
effects.failureSemantics: any failure rolls back; the old question remains active and unchanged
effects.idempotencySemantics: same authorityCommandId retries return the existing superseding version; no duplicate direction change
effects.resultingObject: new ResearchBrief version superseding the prior question
